newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee weakens as RBI buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee weakens as RBI buys dollars.

text.p: The Indian rupee dropped in morning trade on Wednesday as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) continued its dollar purchases, dealers said.
The rupee dropped to 35.875 in mid-morning trade from opening quotes of 35.84/85, they said.
The RBI bought dollars on Monday and Tuesday, pushing the rupee down from its weekend close of 35.745/755. Dealers estimate the total level of intervention in the last two days at $300-400 million.
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted 35.872/882 rupees.
